# Broadband

Pinefibre FTTP, 900/110, no contract term. Chosen for the static IP rather than the
speed, since the server needs a stable address.

## Line

- Account number: PF-119274
- ONT serial: NX8010-4471290
- Static IPv4: 81.201.44.18
- Router: Halcyon SG-8, firmware 4.1.13

## Support

Support is email-only and answers within the hour, which is the reason to stay
with them. The line has dropped twice in a year, both times an the network operator fault
upstream of the ONT.
